title: Embracing Diversity: A Multi-Perspective Approach with Soft Labels

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance (F1-score) and calibration (Expected Calibration Error) on stance detection tasks using a baseline of aggregated hard labels (which represent majority voting and marginalize minority opinions) versus a multi-perspective approach using soft labels (which preserve human disagreement and diverse viewpoints).

Analyzing the label distribution, zero-shot predictions, and inter-annotator agreement percentages of various open-source LLMs (Llama-3, Mistral, Olmo) to identify how their inherent generation patterns skew towards specific perspectives or false positives compared to human annotators on controversial topics.
